limitations: Automatic tonal-coherence and vibe checks are transparent proxies, not human judgments. Borrowed harmony may fail the common-scale heuristic. These checks do not replace listening or a human vibe assessment. Benchmarks apply only to this shortlist and hardware. First request is not cold: no model is unloaded. Ollama residency estimates are not process RSS or total system memory.

settings.percentileMethod: nearest rank; scored requests including failures; first and warmup excluded

proxyDefinitions.minor: At least one minor triad or minor seventh
proxyDefinitions.major-opening: First chord is a major triad, major seventh or dominant seventh
proxyDefinitions.seventh: At least one dominant, major or minor seventh
proxyDefinitions.blues: All chords dominant sevenths with exactly I, IV and V roots for some tonic
proxyDefinitions.coherence: At least 75% whole chords fit one common major or natural-minor pitch-class set; blues uses root relationship instead
proxyDefinitions.variety: At least two distinct chords per progression and three exact ordered chord arrays across the corpus
